_note: 學習路徑內容建置・虛擬語氣：without / but for 的虛擬條件（eng.t_sub.subj.without-but-for，學測／分科級）。without／but for ＋ 名詞＝隱含的虛擬條件，可還原為 If it were not for ...（與現在相反）／If it had not been for ...（與過去相反）；主句依時間用 would／could／might ＋ 原形（現在）或 ＋ have ＋ 過去分詞（過去）。but for 較正式。高階防第二正解：以主句時間（would be vs would have been）鎖定現在或過去，並正確還原為 were not for／had not been for。皆標準英語，形式依 Cambridge / Oxford；claim 標 provisional、待英語母語 reviewer 複核。文法單元無音檔。

units.title_zh: without / but for 的虛擬條件
units.can_do: 我能用 without／but for ＋ 名詞表達隱含的虛擬條件，依主句時間搭配 would ＋ 原形（現在）或 would have ＋ 過去分詞（過去），並能還原成 If it were not for ...／If it had not been for ...。
units.situation_group: 假設語氣 without / but for
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'Without + noun' can carry a present unreal condition, paired with 'would / could / might + base form': Without water, life would not exist.
claims.verification_ref: without ＋ 名詞表現在虛擬條件，主句 would ＋ 原形；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: For a PAST unreal situation, 'without / but for + noun' pairs with 'would / could / might + have + past participle': But for your help, I would have failed.
claims.verification_ref: 過去虛擬：without／but for ＋ 名詞，主句 would have ＋ 過去分詞；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'Without / but for X' can be rewritten as 'If it were not for X' (present) or 'If it had not been for X' (past): Without your support = If it were not for your support.
claims.verification_ref: 還原：without／but for X ＝ If it were not for X（現在）／If it had not been for X（過去）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'But for' has the same meaning as 'without' but is more formal: But for the rain, we would have gone hiking.
claims.verification_ref: but for 意義同 without 但更正式；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: 'Without + noun' can express a hidden unreal condition meaning 'if there were no ...'. For a present situation, pair it with 'would / could / might + base form': 'Without water, life would not exist.' You can rewrite it as 'If it were not for water, life would not exist.'
teach.zh_hint: without ＋ 名詞可以表達隱含的虛擬條件，意思是「要是沒有……」。對現在的情況，主句用 would／could／might ＋ 原形：Without water, life would not exist。可還原成 If it were not for water, life would not exist。

teach.body: Without your advice, I would be completely lost right now.
teach.zh_hint: 要是沒有你的建議，我現在會完全不知所措。現在虛擬→主句 would ＋ 原形 be。

teach.body: For a PAST situation, pair 'without / but for + noun' with 'would / could / might + have + past participle': 'But for your help, I would have failed.' Here 'but for' means the same as 'without' but is more formal, and it can be rewritten as 'If it had not been for your help, I would have failed.'
teach.zh_hint: 對過去的情況，without／but for ＋ 名詞搭配 would／could／might ＋ have ＋ 過去分詞：But for your help, I would have failed。這裡 but for 意思等於 without 但更正式，可還原成 If it had not been for your help, I would have failed。

teach.body: But for the heavy traffic, we would have arrived an hour earlier.
teach.zh_hint: 要不是塞車，我們早一個小時就到了。過去虛擬→主句 would have ＋ 過去分詞 arrived。

practice.stem: 填入正確的形式（對現在的虛擬）：Without the sun, nothing on Earth ____.（要是沒有太陽，地球上什麼都無法存活）

distractor_rationales.would have survived: 這是對『現在』普遍事實的虛擬，主句用 would ＋ 原形(would survive)，不是 would have ＋ 過去分詞（那是過去）。
distractor_rationales.will survive: 與事實相反的虛擬不用 will；現在虛擬用 would ＋ 原形。
distractor_rationales.survived: survived 是過去式，無法表達這裡的現在虛擬結果；用 would survive。

practice.feedback: 現在虛擬：Without the sun, nothing would survive（would ＋ 原形）。

practice.stem: 填入正確的形式（對過去的虛擬）：But for the firefighters, the whole building ____ down.（要不是消防員，整棟大樓早就燒毀了）

distractor_rationales.would burn: 這是對『過去』事件的虛擬（大樓已經被救下來了），主句用 would have ＋ 過去分詞(would have burned)，不是 would ＋ 原形。
distractor_rationales.will burn: 與事實相反的虛擬不用 will；過去虛擬用 would have ＋ 過去分詞。
distractor_rationales.burned: 過去式 burned 無法表達這裡『本來會發生但沒發生』的虛擬結果；用 would have burned。

practice.feedback: 過去虛擬：But for the firefighters, the building would have burned down。

practice.stem: 選出與『Without your support, I would give up.』意思相同的句子：
practice.answer: If it were not for your support, I would give up.
options: If it were not for your support, I would give up.
If it had not been for your support, I would give up.
If you support me, I will give up.
Unless your support, I would give up.

distractor_rationales.If it had not been for your support, I w: had not been for 是『過去』的還原；原句主句 would give up 是現在虛擬，應還原成 If it were not for。
這是真實條件句（直說），語意也相反；原句是與現在事實相反的虛擬。
unless 後要接子句（有動詞），不能直接接名詞 your support；此句不合語法。

practice.feedback: 現在虛擬還原：Without X ＝ If it were not for X：If it were not for your support, I would give up。

practice.stem: 選出與『But for the map, we would have got lost.』意思相同的句子：
practice.answer: If it had not been for the map, we would have got lost.
options: If it had not been for the map, we would have got lost.
If it were not for the map, we would have got lost.
If we had a map, we would get lost.
Without the map, we will get lost.

distractor_rationales.If it were not for the map, we would hav: were not for 是『現在』的還原；原句主句 would have got 是過去虛擬，應還原成 If it had not been for。
語意相反（原句是靠地圖才沒迷路），且 would get 是現在虛擬，與過去不符。
will get 是真實未來（直說），與原句的過去虛擬不符。

practice.feedback: 過去虛擬還原：But for X ＝ If it had not been for X：If it had not been for the map, we would have got lost。

practice.stem: 用 without 改寫（對過去的虛擬）：'If it had not been for your warning, I would have made a big mistake.' → 'Without ____, I would have made a big mistake.'
practice.answer: Without your warning, I would have made a big mistake.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：If it had not been for X ＝ Without X，主句維持 would have ＋ 過去分詞：Without your warning, I would have made a big mistake。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 純文字朗讀＋語調模仿（無音檔，自己朗讀→自評）：without／but for ＋ 名詞後略停再接主句；主句 would be／would have ＋ 過去分詞稍清楚以區分現在與過去，句尾下收。

lines.text: Without your help, I would never finish this on time.
lines.intonation: without your help 後略停、would never finish 稍強調、句尾下收

lines.text: But for the storm, we would have reached the summit.
lines.intonation: but for the storm 後略停、would have reached 清楚、句尾下收
